name: Chief arena steward
design: Stocky broad mature male with olive speckled hide, wide exposed four mandibles, broad domed cranium and thick shoulder-length dreadlocks. Warm ochre short-sleeved tunic with one broad folded charcoal shoulder shawl, bronze shoulder clasp, heavy leather belt with simple unmarked seals, black apron panels to knees. Holds a short rounded signal baton down beside leg, other hand on waist. Civilian event official, no battle armor.
